name: adobe-mcp-illustrator

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description: Describe the active document: name, file, colour mode, artboards with their sizes, layers, item counts and selection

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List the open documents and which one is active

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a document. The colour mode cannot be changed later without converting every colour, so choose CMYK for print and RGB for screen

colorMode.description: CMYK for print, RGB for screen

width.description: Artboard width in points (72 pt = 1 in). Default 612

artboardLayout.description: How several artboards are arranged. Default GridByRow

artboardSpacing.description: Space between artboards in points. Default 20

columns.description: Columns (or rows, for column layouts) in a grid

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open an .ai, .pdf, .eps or .svg file

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Save the active document. With filePath, save it as an Illustrator (.ai) or Illustrator EPS (.eps) file there; the document then refers to that file. Can also save each artboard to its own file

filePath.description: Absolute .ai or .eps path. Omit to save in place

compatibility.description: Illustrator version to save for: 24 = Illustrator 2020 and later (default), 17 = CC, 16 = CS6

separateArtboards.description: Also save each artboard to its own file, named after the artboard. Default false

artboards.description: With separateArtboards: the artboards to save, 1-based: "1", "1-3,5". Default all

pdfCompatible.description: .ai: embed a PDF-compatible copy so other apps can preview it. Default true

embedIccProfile.description: .ai: embed the document's colour profile. Default true

fontSubsetThreshold.description: .ai: subset embedded fonts when less than this percent of their characters is used. Default 100

cmykPostScript.description: .eps: include CMYK PostScript in RGB files. Default true

compatibleGradientPrinting.description: .eps: rasterise gradients and meshes for older PostScript printers. Default false

overprint.description: .eps: keep or discard overprints. Default preserve

tools.name: close_document
tools.description: Close the active document. Unsaved changes are discarded unless save is true

tools.name: list_artboards
tools.description: List artboards with their position and size in points. x and y are measured from artboard 0's top-left corner

tools.name: add_artboard
tools.description: Add an artboard. x and y are measured from artboard 0's top-left corner, in points

tools.name: set_artboard
tools.description: Rename, move or resize an artboard. Position is measured from artboard 0's top-left corner

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

tools.name: delete_artboard
tools.description: Delete an artboard. Its artwork stays on the canvas. The last artboard cannot be deleted

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

tools.name: set_active_artboard
tools.description: Make an artboard active (the one Illustrator's artboard commands and menu commands act on)

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

tools.name: fit_artboard_to_artwork
tools.description: Resize an artboard to the bounds of the selected artwork

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: rearrange_artboards
tools.description: Arrange all artboards in a grid, row or column

moveArtwork.description: Move artwork with its artboard. Default true

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: List top-level layers and their sublayers, with visibility, lock state and item counts

tools.name: create_layer
tools.description: Create a layer at the top of the stack, or as a sublayer of parentLayer

tools.name: set_layer_properties
tools.description: Rename a layer, show or hide it, lock it, set whether it prints, its opacity, or move it in the stack

tools.name: set_active_layer
tools.description: Make a layer active: new artwork goes on it when a tool is not given a layer

tools.name: delete_layer
tools.description: Delete a layer and everything on it

tools.name: move_items_to_layer
tools.description: Move items to the top of another layer

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: create_rectangle
tools.description: Draw a rectangle, optionally with rounded corners. x and y are the top-left corner in points from the artboard's top-left

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

fill.description: Fill. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

stroke.description: Stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

tools.name: create_ellipse
tools.description: Draw an ellipse inside the box whose top-left corner is x, y

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

fill.description: Fill. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

stroke.description: Stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

tools.name: create_polygon
tools.description: Draw a regular polygon centred on centerX, centerY

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

fill.description: Fill. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

stroke.description: Stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

tools.name: create_star
tools.description: Draw a star centred on centerX, centerY

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

fill.description: Fill. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

stroke.description: Stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

tools.name: create_line
tools.description: Draw a straight line from x1, y1 to x2, y2

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

fill.description: Fill. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

stroke.description: Stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

tools.name: create_path
tools.description: Draw a path through points. Each point is [x, y], or an object with x, y and optional curve handles in and out ([x, y] in the same coordinates)

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

fill.description: Fill. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

stroke.description: Stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

tools.name: create_text
tools.description: Add text. Point text grows with its content from x, y (the left end of the first baseline); area text flows inside a box of width and height whose top-left is x, y

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

contents.description: The text. Use \r for new paragraphs

leading.description: Leading in points (turns off auto leading)

tracking.description: Tracking in thousandths of an em

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

tools.name: set_text_style
tools.description: Set font, size, colour, justification, leading or tracking on whole text frames

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: set_text_contents
tools.description: Replace the text of text frames. Character formatting of the first character is kept

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: convert_text_to_outlines
tools.description: Convert text frames to outlined artwork (Type > Create Outlines). The text is no longer editable

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.description: List installed fonts whose name, family or style contains the query

tools.name: set_fill
tools.description: Set the fill of paths, compound paths, groups (every path inside) and text frames. "none" removes the fill

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tint.description: Tint percent of a spot or global swatch. Default 100

tools.name: set_stroke
tools.description: Set the stroke of paths, compound paths and groups: colour, weight, caps, joins and dashes

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tint.description: Tint percent of a spot or global swatch. Default 100

dashes.description: Dash and gap lengths in points, e.g. [12, 6]. [] for a solid line

tools.name: set_opacity
tools.description: Set the opacity and blending mode of items

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: get_appearance
tools.description: Read the fill, stroke, opacity and blending mode of items

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: list_swatches
tools.description: List the document's swatches with their kind (process, global, spot), colour values and swatch group

tools.name: create_swatch
tools.description: Add a swatch: a process colour, a global process colour (editing it updates every object that uses it), or a spot colour (an ink such as a Pantone colour or a varnish plate). Optionally put it in a swatch group

color.description: "cmyk(c,m,y,k)", "rgb(r,g,b)", "#RRGGBB" or "gray(g)"; a spot colour can also be "lab(L,a,b)"

spot.description: Create a spot colour. Default false

global.description: Create a global process colour. Default false

group.description: Swatch group to put it in, created if needed

tools.name: create_gradient
tools.description: Add a linear or radial gradient swatch from colour stops, and optionally apply it as the fill of items

applyTo.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

angle.description: Angle in degrees for linear gradients applied to items

tools.name: edit_colors
tools.description: Recolour the targets with an Edit > Edit Colors command: convert to CMYK, RGB or grayscale, invert, or blend the fills between the frontmost and backmost (or leftmost and rightmost, topmost and bottommost) objects

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: create_swatch_group
tools.description: Create a swatch group (a colour group in the Swatches panel), optionally moving existing swatches into it

swatches.description: Names of existing swatches to move into the group

tools.name: delete_swatches
tools.description: Delete swatches by name

tools.name: add_used_colors
tools.description: Add a swatch for each process colour used in the fills and strokes of the artwork (Swatches panel > Add Used Colors), skipping colours that already have one. Swatches are named the way Illustrator names them, e.g. "C=0 M=60 Y=100 K=0"

target.description: Only these items. Default the whole document

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

group.description: Put the new swatches in this swatch group, created if needed

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: List items with their id, name, type, layer and position. Filter by layer, artboard or type. Ids are what other tools take in target.ids

layer.description: Only items on this layer (and its sublayers)

artboardIndex.description: Only items whose centre is on this artboard

topLevelOnly.description: Skip items inside groups. Default true

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Describe the current selection

tools.name: select_items
tools.description: Select items (replacing the current selection). Menu commands act on the selection

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: deselect_all
tools.description: Deselect everything in the active document

tools.name: select_same
tools.description: Select every object that shares an attribute with the targets (Select > Same), e.g. all objects with the same fill colour. The targets are selected first and set the attribute

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: select_all
tools.description: Select all unlocked, visible objects in the document, or on one artboard (Select > All, All on Active Artboard)

artboardIndex.description: Only this artboard (0-based). Default the whole document

tools.name: delete_items
tools.description: Delete items from the document (Illustrator's Edit > Undo can restore them)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: duplicate_items
tools.description: Duplicate items, offsetting each copy by dx, dy points. With count > 1, each copy is offset from the previous one (step and repeat)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: move_items
tools.description: Move items by dx, dy points, or place their top-left corner at x, y on an artboard

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

tools.name: scale_items
tools.description: Scale items by a percentage. Give scale for uniform scaling, or scaleX and scaleY

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

origin.description: Point to transform around. Default center

scaleStrokes.description: Scale stroke weights too. Default true

tools.name: rotate_items
tools.description: Rotate items by an angle in degrees (counter-clockwise, as in Illustrator)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

origin.description: Point to transform around. Default center

tools.name: reflect_items
tools.description: Flip items horizontally or vertically around their centre

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: align_items
tools.description: Align items to each other (their combined bounds) or to an artboard

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

tools.name: arrange_items
tools.description: Change stacking order: bring to front, bring forward, send backward, send to back

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: group_items
tools.description: Group items. The group is created where the frontmost item is

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: ungroup_items
tools.description: Ungroup groups, leaving their contents in place

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: make_clipping_mask
tools.description: Clip items with a path: the clipping path shows only the artwork inside it. clipPath must be a path id; it is moved above the other items

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

clipPathId.description: Id of the path to clip with

tools.name: make_compound_path
tools.description: Combine paths into one compound path (Object > Compound Path > Make): overlapping areas become holes

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: path_operation
tools.description: Run an Object > Path command on the targets: outline_stroke (stroke to filled shape), join (connect open paths' end points), add_anchor_points (one between each pair), reverse_direction, divide_objects_below (cut everything beneath with the target's shape), release_compound_path, make_pixel_perfect, expand_appearance

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: average_points
tools.description: Average anchor points (Object > Path > Average): move them onto one horizontal line, one vertical line, or one point. Handles move with their anchors. With join, connect the averaged end points afterwards (Average & Join)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

axis.description: horizontal: same y (a horizontal line); vertical: same x; both: one point

selectedPointsOnly.description: Only anchor points selected with the Direct Selection tool. Default false: every anchor of the targets

join.description: Join the end points afterwards. Default false

tools.name: clean_up
tools.description: Remove stray points (single-anchor paths), unpainted paths (no fill, no stroke) and empty text from the document (Object > Path > Clean Up). Locked and hidden objects, clipping paths, guides and the paths inside compound paths are left alone

tools.name: split_into_grid
tools.description: Split each target into a grid of rectangles (Object > Path > Split Into Grid): rows and columns with gutters, taking the target's fill, stroke and opacity. The target is replaced. Optionally add guides along the grid

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

gutter.description: Points between cells, both ways. Default 0

addGuides.description: Add guides along the cell edges. Default false

tools.name: split_path
tools.description: Cut a path at one of its anchor points (like the Scissors tool). An open path becomes two paths; a closed path opens there. Point indexes come from get_path_info

target.description: One path

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: set_path_options
tools.description: Set path attributes on paths (inside groups and compound paths too): even-odd or non-zero fill rule, closed or open, make or release guides, and align to pixel grid

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

evenOdd.description: true: even-odd fill rule; false: non-zero winding

guide.description: true: make the paths guides (View > Guides > Make Guides); false: release them

pixelAligned.description: Align to Pixel Grid (applies to the targets themselves)

tools.name: get_path_info
tools.description: Describe paths (inside groups and compound paths too): closed, fill rule, guide, anchor count, area and length, and optionally every anchor point with its handles and type, in artboard coordinates

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: apply_effect
tools.description: Apply a Live Effect to items: it stays editable in the Appearance panel unless expand is true, which turns the result into plain artwork. Options per effect: drop_shadow: opacity = 75 [Percent], x = 7 [Horizontal offset in points], y = 7 [Vertical offset in points (down is positive)], blur = 5 [Blur in points], darkness = 100 [Percent of black mixed into the shadow]; offset_path: offset (required) [Points; negative shrinks the shape], joins round|bevel|miter = miter, miterLimit = 4; round_corners: radius (required) [Points]; roughen: size = 5 [Percent of the object's size], detail = 10 [Points per inch], smooth = true [Smooth points (false: corner points)]; transform: scale = 100 [Percent], moveX = 0 [Points], moveY = 0 [Points (down is positive)], rotate = 0 [Degrees], copies = 0 [Extra transformed copies (0: transform only)]; gaussian_blur: radius (required) [Pixels]

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

options.description: The effect's options, as listed in the tool description

expand.description: Expand the result to plain artwork (Object > Expand Appearance). Default false

tools.name: pathfinder
tools.description: Combine shapes as the Pathfinder panel does: unite, minus front, intersect, exclude, divide, trim, merge, crop, outline, minus back. The items are grouped and the Pathfinder effect applied; with expand (default) the result becomes plain paths, otherwise it stays a live effect on the group

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

expand.description: Expand the result to plain paths. Default true

removeRedundantPoints.description: Pathfinder Options > Remove Redundant Points. Default false

removeUnpainted.description: Divide and Outline: remove unpainted artwork. Default false

method.description: effect (default) applies the Pathfinder effect; menu runs the Live Pathfinder menu command on the selection instead

tools.name: get_preferences
tools.description: Read Illustrator preferences: usePreviewBounds, scaleStrokesAndEffects, transformPatterns, keyboardIncrement, cornerRadius, smartGuidesAlignment, smartGuidesConstruction, smartGuidesLabels, smartGuidesHighlighting, smartGuidesMeasurements, smartGuidesTransformTools, snapToPoint, showPixelGrid, penAutoAddDelete, highlightAnchorsOnHover, preciseCursors, toolTips, japaneseCropMarks, englishFontNames. Omit names to read them all

tools.name: set_preferences
tools.description: Change Illustrator preferences. They persist, as if set in the Preferences dialog. Pass an object of name: value

usePreviewBounds.description: Measure objects including stroke width and effects (General > Use Preview Bounds)

scaleStrokesAndEffects.description: Scale stroke weights and effects when scaling objects

keyboardIncrement.description: Distance an arrow key moves a selection, in points

cornerRadius.description: Default corner radius for rounded rectangles, in points

smartGuidesLabels.description: Smart Guides: anchor and path labels

showPixelGrid.description: Show the pixel grid at high zoom

penAutoAddDelete.description: Disable the Pen tool's automatic add/delete anchor (true disables it)

tools.name: select_tool
tools.description: Switch Illustrator to a tool, ready for the user to draw with it. Name it as Illustrator does, e.g. "Pen Tool", "Shape Builder Tool", "Width Tool"

tools.name: make_blend
tools.description: Blend two or more objects (Object > Blend > Make), optionally setting the number of steps and the orientation. The objects blend in stacking order

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

steps.description: Number of steps between the blended objects (Blend Options > Spacing: Specified Steps)

orientation.description: page: steps stay upright; path: steps turn with the spine. Default page

tools.name: set_blend_options
tools.description: Set the number of steps and the orientation of existing blends (Object > Blend > Blend Options)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

steps.description: Number of steps between the blended objects (Blend Options > Spacing: Specified Steps)

orientation.description: page: steps stay upright; path: steps turn with the spine. Default page

tools.name: release_blend
tools.description: Release blends back into their original objects (Object > Blend > Release)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: expand_blend
tools.description: Expand blends so every step becomes an ordinary object (Object > Blend > Expand)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tools.name: reverse_blend
tools.description: Reverse a blend's spine (the order along the path) or its stacking order (front to back)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

what.description: spine: Reverse Spine; stack: Reverse Front to Back

tools.name: place_image
tools.description: Place an image or other file (PNG, JPEG, TIFF, PSD, PDF, SVG, AI) at x, y on an artboard, linked or embedded. Give width to scale it proportionally

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

width.description: Scale proportionally to this width in points

embed.description: Embed instead of linking. Default false

tools.name: export_png
tools.description: Export artboards as PNG files, one per artboard, at a scale (100 = 72 ppi, 300 = 216 ppi)

artboards.description: Artboards to export, 1-based like Illustrator: "1", "1-3,5". Default all

prefix.description: File name prefix. Default the document name

tools.name: export_jpeg

instructions:
Tools drive a running Adobe Illustrator (2023 or later, macOS or Windows) on the user's machine.

Start with illustrator_status if you are unsure Illustrator is reachable. Most tools act on the active document: create_document or open_document first, and get_document_info for its artboards and layers.

Conventions:
- Positions and sizes are points (72 pt = 1 in), measured from the top-left corner of an artboard (artboardIndex, default 0) with y increasing downward. Results report positions the same way.
- Items are chosen with target: { ids: [...] } (ids come from list_items and from every tool that creates artwork), { names: [...] }, or { selection: true }.
- Colours are a swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)", "cmyk(c,m,y,k)", "gray(g)" or "none". A document's colour mode (CMYK or RGB) is fixed when it is created; colours given in the other model are converted.
- Fonts are PostScript names (list_fonts).
- File paths must be absolute and inside the user's home folder or ILLUSTRATOR_ALLOWED_DIRS.

Illustrator gives no result from menu commands: execute_menu_command reports the selection and document afterwards, and an unknown command name does nothing. A command that opens a dialog waits for the user; if a call times out, a dialog is probably open in Illustrator.

A call that fails returns isError with a message: read it and fix the arguments rather than retrying unchanged. A result with "warnings" names arguments that were ignored. Annotations mark destructive tools (delete_*, close_document, set_text_contents, convert_text_to_outlines, execute_illustrator_code); confirm with the user before using them on unsaved work. print_document sends a job to a real printer unless outputFile is given: confirm the printer and options with the user first.

help({ tool }) describes any tool's parameters.
